kept.decision_summary: In a May 14, 2025 report to the TTC Board on transit priority on Dufferin Street and Bathurst Street, TTC staff proposed removing four low-ridership bus stops on the Bathurst bus section (north of Bathurst Station). The report says this is to improve safety, transit speed and reliability, and to meet TTC service standards. It also says the stop removals were still part of ongoing consultation and could change, so this is a proposal, not a confirmed removal.
kept.quote: The following low-ridership bus stops are proposed to be removed: Dewbourne Avenue, Ardmore Road, Heathdale Road and Barton Avenue.

kept.decision_summary: On May 14, 2025, the TTC Board endorsed priority bus lanes in both directions on Bathurst Street from Eglinton Avenue to Bathurst Station (Barton Avenue), where the 7 Bathurst bus runs. The staff report also proposed removing on-street parking and adding no-stopping rules and turn restrictions. However, the City Council report for this item (July 2, 2025) asked for approval only for Bathurst Street from Bathurst Station south to Lake Shore Boulevard West (the 511 streetcar). It left the section between Bloor Street West and Eglinton Avenue West for a future report after the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
kept.quote: Endorsed the proposed installation of priority bus lanes in both directions on Bathurst Street between Eglinton Avenue East and Bathurst Station (Barton Avenue).

kept.decision_summary: The City staff report to Executive Committee (July 2, 2025) asked for authority to build transit priority on Bathurst Street only from Bathurst Station to Lake Shore Boulevard West, to be ready for the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Staff would report back after the World Cup with an evaluation, which could include removing the measures, and with next steps for Bathurst Street between Bloor Street West and Eglinton Avenue West, the 7 Bathurst bus section.
kept.quote: as well as recommendations for next steps for future implementation of RapidTO segments on Dufferin Street and Bathurst Street between Bloor Street West and Eglinton Avenue West.
